hypotheses.claim: A target-calibrated active sensing controller with explicit global coverage debt can reduce deep-vision tokens and full decoder calls while preserving hidden-operation detection, grounding and task success better than ROI-only and at lower total cost than full-frame-every-cycle.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: Selective confidence is too brittle under GUI distribution shift and the controller adds enough extra sensing/control overhead that a simple periodic-anchor hybrid dominates.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched held-out GUI/action episodes show no Pareto gain versus HYBRID_PERIODIC_ANCHOR across task success, hidden-operation misses, grounding, visual tokens, decoder calls, latency and resources.
hypotheses.cheapest_discriminating_test: Offline replay with identical episodes comparing FULL_FRAME, ROI_ONLY, ROI_PLUS_CONTEXT, HYBRID_PERIODIC_ANCHOR and PBC_COVERAGE_DEBT using frozen target-model calibration; include modal-outside-ROI, background transition, small-text, wrong-confidence, model/interface-shift and post-action mismatch fixtures.

hypotheses.claim: The libmtmd media embedding boundary is suitable for synchronous one-encode MVC tapping, but safe reuse beyond the owning batch lifetime requires an explicit owned, bounded, versioned descriptor cache rather than retaining raw embedding pointers.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: Native runtime multimodal cache/KV behavior already provides equivalent safe reuse, or cross-request descriptor caching provides no net benefit over re-encode/on-demand paths.
hypotheses.falsifier: Runtime inspection/measurement demonstrates native version-safe cross-request reuse with no second encode, or VEC does not reduce pathway cost while preserving stale/version mismatch rejection.
hypotheses.cheapest_discriminating_test: Instrument encode invocation count and batch lifetime; compare NO_CACHE, NATIVE_RUNTIME_CACHE_ONLY and VEC_OWNED_DESCRIPTOR across same-frame, changed-frame, mmproj-swap, preprocess-swap, crash/restart and concurrent-slot fixtures.

architecture_delta.proposed_change: Insert a typed PerceptualBudgetController after deterministic change/provenance extraction and before/around Qwen vision escalation. It selects no-deep-vision, ROI+context, coarse-global, targeted-zoom or full-frame observation from calibrated uncertainty, visual alias conflict, task/action criticality, topology change and coverage debt. Couple the synchronous libmtmd VisionFeatureTap to a VersionedVisualEvidenceCache containing only owned bounded descriptors and receipts keyed by exact source/model/mmproj/preprocess/projection/token-budget/crop identities.
architecture_delta.authority: Cached/retrieved visual evidence remains evidence/context only. It cannot mint truth, task completion, GWT causal credit or effect authority.
architecture_delta.rollback: Disable PBC and VEC independently; revert to deterministic change gate + existing hybrid anchor/Qwen path; invalidate cache by schema/version epoch.

test_obligations.pass_rule: No promotion from token savings alone. PBC must be Pareto-competitive with HYBRID_PERIODIC_ANCHOR and must not worsen hidden-operation or grounding failure beyond frozen tolerance.
Any unowned-pointer persistence or silent version-mismatch reuse is FAIL. VEC survives only if it provides measurable benefit over native/no-cache baselines.

research_progress_delta.description: Sharpened q23 from generic ROI/token budgeting into target-calibrated active sensing with explicit coverage debt, and from generic feature-tap lifetime warning into an exact owned/versioned cache boundary. This adds falsifiers not present in the parent runtime-scale or VSTG hypotheses.
